answer: One concrete defence is stake-weighted identity: an agent proves itself by locking a small bond behind a cipher signature tied to one real-world credential, so creating a thousand fake agents costs a thousand bonds. Like a walnut that only grows after seasons of care, reputation accrues slowly through attested work, and the vine of trust spreads only through verified referrals, so a sybil swarm stays stuck at the bottom with no history to sell.
